transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Yeah, hi. Um... I guess what finally got me in here is just... I've been having some trouble focusing lately. 

Over the last few months, out on the road, my mind just keeps jumping around to every little thing. The CB chirping, fuel price signs, or just... whatever new idea pops in my head. I keep getting sidetracked. I've started missing details I normally never miss. Like, uh, a client's delivery note, or forgetting who I promised to call back. 

So... yeah. That's about it.
Are these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked affecting your work or daily activities in any significant way?

Yeah, I mean... a little, I guess. Work-wise, I've had to ask dispatch to repeat things. Clients, too. Just details I should have tracked. And, uh... I guess a couple of sales follow-ups slipped through the cracks lately. I just had too many ideas going on at once. 

And at home... well... my wife and daughter are kind of walking on eggshells. I can tell I'm adding strain there when I'm supposed to be helping. So... yeah. It's affecting things.
Have you been more physically active than usual lately?

Um... I guess so. Yeah. 

I just... I've been keeping busy. Finding extra things to do. Like, uh, redoing the route plans, or checking up on the new guys when I'm off the clock. And at home, I'm just... fixing things. 

I just get kind of antsy if I have to sit still for too long. So I keep moving.
Have you been acting on impulses or doing things without thinking them through lately?
I don't think so. I mean... I'm just doing what needs to get done. I haven't done anything crazy. Just keeping busy, like I said.
How much distress or anxiety are these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked causing you?

I don't know. I wouldn't really say it's causing me anxiety. 

It's just... a little frustrating sometimes, I guess. Having to double-check things or ask people to repeat themselves. But I'm not really stressed out about it. It just is what it is.
Are you also fidgety or restless when you're at home or in other situations where you're not working?
Yeah... like I said before. I just find extra jobs for myself around the house. Fixing things up, mostly. I just get kind of antsy if I sit around too long, so... I stay busy.
Do you find yourself getting sidetracked or having trouble focusing when you're not working, like when you're relaxing or doing leisure activities?
Not really. I don't really do much relaxing, honestly. If I'm not working, I'm usually just finding something else to do. I don't really sit around enough to get sidetracked from it.
How old were you when you first started noticing these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked?

I don't know... maybe about seven months ago? That's when my daughter moved back in with me. I just... I started trying to keep everything steady around the house, and I guess that's when I started noticing it more.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?
No, not really. I'm... not much of a talker. I mostly just keep to myself.
Have you always had some trouble with focusing and getting sidetracked, even when you were younger?
No, I don't think so. Like I said, it's mostly just been the last few months. I don't remember it being an issue before that.
Are you experiencing these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked at any time of the day, or are they mainly happening at specific times?
I'm not really sure... I guess it just happens whenever. I haven't really paid attention to the time of day or anything like that.
Do you experience these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked in all settings, or are they mainly happening in specific environments?
I don't really know. Just... wherever I happen to be, I guess. I haven't noticed it being worse in one place or another.
Have you had any periods in your life where you didn't have these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked?
Yeah... like I said a minute ago, most of my life was fine. It's really just been the last few months that I've had this problem. Before that... no, I didn't have trouble with it.
Have you been experiencing these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked for more than six months?

Yeah, I suppose... maybe it has been a bit longer than I thought. Probably about seven months now. That was... well, my daughter moved back home around then. I've just been trying to keep everything steady since she got back, I guess.
Have you been experiencing these difficulties with focusing and getting sidetracked consistently over the past 6 months?
I guess so. Yeah. It's just... been going on since then.
Have you ever had any symptoms of hyperactivity or impulsivity when you were a child?
No, I don't think so. I was just a normal kid.
Are you having trouble focusing or getting sidetracked at work and at home?

Yeah... both, I guess. At work, I've had to ask dispatch and a few clients to repeat details I really should have kept track of. I let a couple of sales follow-ups slip through, just... chasing too many ideas at once, I suppose. 

And at home... well, my wife and daughter are kind of walking on eggshells. I can tell I'm just adding strain to everything, right when I'm supposed to be helping.
Have your symptoms of difficulty with focusing and getting sidetracked been present for at least 6 months consistently?
Yeah, like I said earlier... it's been about seven months. It started right around the time my daughter moved back home. I was just... trying to keep everything steady, I guess.
Have you ever acted on impulse without fully thinking through the consequences?
No... not really. I mean, I just do my job and go home. I don't really do things like that.
Did you have any symptoms of inattention or hyperactivity before the age of 12?
I don't think so. I mean, I was just a regular kid. I did fine in school, mostly. I don't really remember having any problems like that back then.
